summary: Added an Expansion Roadmap workspace to the Office of the Steward command center, keeping roadmap planning separate from Active Projects and Daily Board while surfacing evidence-backed states, upcoming epics, pending architecture decisions, planned inactive initiatives, future work package candidates, dependency notes, and source provenance.
known_limitations: The workspace summarizes local artifacts only and does not create approvals, governance, or automatic work package promotion.
Roadmap extraction is intentionally conservative and relies on existing Markdown tables, mission registry entries, Parking Lot candidates, and ADR files where present.
